Package model

Class Patient

java.lang.Object
model.Patient
public class Patient extends Object
Represents a patient registered in the hospital management system. Stores personal details including contact information and demographics.

  • Constructor Details

    • Patient

      public Patient(String name, LocalDate dob, String phone, String address, String gender)
      Constructs a new Patient without an ID. Used when registering a new patient (ID is assigned by the database).
      Parameters:
      name - the patient's full name
      dob - the patient's date of birth
      phone - the patient's phone number
      address - the patient's address
      gender - the patient's gender

    • Patient

      public Patient()
      Default no-argument constructor. Required for frameworks or manual field-by-field construction.

    • Patient

      public Patient(int patientId, String name, LocalDate dob, String phone, String address, String gender)
      Constructs a Patient with all fields populated. Used when loading an existing patient record from the database.
      Parameters:
      patientId - the patient's unique ID
      name - the patient's full name
      dob - the patient's date of birth
      phone - the patient's phone number
      address - the patient's address
      gender - the patient's gender

    • Patient

      public Patient(String name, LocalDate dob, String phone, String address, String gender, int receptionistId)
      Constructs a Patient with all fields populated. Used when loading an existing patient record from the database.
      Parameters:
      name - the patient's full name
      dob - the patient's date of birth
      phone - the patient's phone number
      address - the patient's address
      gender - the patient's gender
      receptionistId - the id of the receptionist that logged into the system
